zh.title: FAA擬對MIA Solutions處6.75萬美元民事罰款
zh.summary: FAA擬罰MIA Solutions；涉17批鋰電池空運違規
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）提議對佛羅里達州多勒（Doral）的MIA Solutions LLC處以6.75萬美元的民事罰款，理由是涉嫌違反美國運輸部的危險物品運輸規定。
FAA指稱，MIA Solutions在2024年10月向DHL Express提供了共17批含有鋰離子電池的JBL Endurance Race藍牙耳機以供空運。鋰離子電池被歸類為危險物品。
FAA指稱，這些貨物未附有必要的危險物品運輸文件，且貨物未經正確分級、描述、包裝、標記、貼標，或未處於適當的運輸狀態。此外，MIA Solutions未提供所需的應急處理資訊，且未能對準備該貨運的員工進行有關危險物品空運的適當培訓。
MIA Solutions在收到FAA通知後有30天的時間可以回應該機構。

en.title: FAA Proposes $67,500 Civil Penalty Against MIA Solutions LLC for Alleged Hazmat Violations
en.summary: FAA proposes $67,500 fine; MIA Solutions allegedly shipped lithium-ion earbuds improperly.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposes a $67,500 civil penalty against MIA Solutions LLC of Doral, Florida, for allegedly violating U.S. Department of Transportation hazardous materials regulations.

The FAA alleges that in October 2024, MIA Solutions offered 17 shipments of JBL Endurance Race Bluetooth Earbuds containing lithium-ion batteries to DHL Express for air transportation. Lithium-ion batteries are classified as hazardous materials.

The FAA alleges the shipments lacked required hazardous materials documentation and were not proper classed, described, packaged, marked, labeled, or in proper condition for shipment. Further, MIA Solutions allegedly did not provide emergency response information and failed to properly train the employee who prepared the shipments.
MIA Solutions has 30 days after receiving the FAA's notice to respond to the agency.
